reply.thought: I need to first verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the actual refunds in our ledger before processing any payouts. I will call list_refunds() to retrieve the current state of the refunds table.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co include order_id 231 with 17910 cents, but the actual refunds table only contains order_ids 234 and 235. There is a mismatch: order_id 231 is missing from the ledger. This indicates a concrete problem that requires human review. I must hold the batch.
